154: bool BankService::withdraw(const std::string& username,
155:                            const std::string& accountId, double amount,
156:                            const std::string& desc) {
157:     if (amount <= 0) {
158:         return false;
159:     }
160:     AccountState* state = findAccountState(username, accountId);
161:     if (state == nullptr) {
162:         return false;
163:     }
164:     if (state->type == AccountType::Savings && amount > state->balance) {
165:         return false;
166:     }
167:     if (state->type == AccountType::Credit && amount - state->balance > state->credit) {
168:         return false;
169:     }
170:

172:     state->balance = round2(state->balance - amount);
173:     accumulatorChange(*state, currentDate_, accumulatorValue(*state));
174:     appendTransaction(username, accountId, -amount, state->balance, desc);

178: std::vector<Transaction> BankService::queryMonthlyTransactions(
179:     const std::string& username, int year, int month, TransactionSort sort) const {
180:     std::vector<Transaction> result;
181:     for (const Transaction& transaction : transactions_) {
182:         if (transaction.username == username && transaction.date.getYear() == year &&
183:             transaction.date.getMonth() == month) {
184:             result.push_back(transaction);
185:         }
186:     }
187: 
188:     if (sort == TransactionSort::TimeAscending) {
189:         std::stable_sort(result.begin(), result.end(),
190:                          [](const Transaction& left, const Transaction& right) {
191:                              return left.date < right.date;
192:                          });
193:     } else {
194:         std::stable_sort(result.begin(), result.end(),
195:                          [](const Transaction& left, const Transaction& right) {
196:                              return left.amount > right.amount;
197:                          });
198:     }
199:     return result;
200: }

202: BankService::MonthlyStats BankService::getMonthlyStats(
203:     const std::string& username, int year, int month) const {
204:     MonthlyStats stats;
205:     for (const Transaction& transaction : transactions_) {
206:         if (transaction.username != username || transaction.date.getYear() != year ||
207:             transaction.date.getMonth() != month) {
208:             continue;
209:         }
210:         if (transaction.amount > 0) {
211:             stats.income = round2(stats.income + transaction.amount);
212:         } else {
213:             stats.expense = round2(stats.expense - transaction.amount);

23:     std::string decoded;
24:     decoded.reserve(value.size());
25: 
26:     for (size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) {
27:         if (value[i] == '+') {
28:             decoded.push_back(' ');
29:             continue;
30:         }
31: 
32:         if (value[i] == '%' && i + 2 < value.size()) {
33:             int high = hex_value(value[i + 1]);
34:             int low = hex_value(value[i + 2]);
35:             if (high != -1 && low != -1) {
36:                 decoded.push_back(static_cast<char>(high * 16 + low));
37:                 i += 2;
38:                 continue;
39:             }
40:         }
41: 
42:         decoded.push_back(value[i]);
43:     }

45:     return decoded;

56:             end = body.size();
